annotations.description: Gifted Aetherborn (2/3 deathtouch lifelink) should attack here. The only untapped blocker is Pestermite (2/1) and the opponent has zero untapped mana for tricks. If Pestermite blocks, Aetherborn kills it with deathtouch, gains 2 life from lifelink, and survives. If unblocked, deals 2 and gains 2. Both outcomes are pure upside. Additionally, the lifelink could help enable Sanguine Indulgence's cost reduction later.

annotations.description: GptOSS Snark is at 4 life facing a Gloom Sower (8/6) and Gifted Aetherborn (2/3 with deathtouch/lifelink) on the opponent's side. The opponent is at 11 life. Vendilion Clique is a 3/1 flash flyer that could be cast at instant speed later (e.g., on opponent's draw step or end step), but passing priority in the precombat main phase without casting it or equipping Malefic Scythe to a creature is a significant missed opportunity. With Malefic Scythe having 1 soul counter (+1/+1), equipping it to Eternal Taskmaster (making it 3/4) or Sentinels of Glen Elendra would improve board presence. More importantly, at 4 life with the opponent having an 8/6 and a 2/3 lifelinker, the player needs to maximize every resource. While Vendilion Clique has flash and could be cast later, passing the entire main phase without even equipping the Scythe (which costs {1} and is sorcery speed) wastes the equip opportunity entirely for this turn.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed priority in precombat main phase without casting Vendilion Clique or equipping Malefic Scythe.
annotations.betterLine: Equip Malefic Scythe to Sentinels of Glen Elendra (making it 4/5 flying) to have a stronger blocker against the Gloom Sower, then hold up Vendilion Clique for flash deployment. The equipped Sentinels could block the 8/6 Gloom Sower without dying, which is critical at 4 life. Alternatively, equip to Eternal Taskmaster to make it a 3/4 for better blocking options.
